searchText: Starting a thread, do we want this change in devnet 3 for 8024: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11094 i'm opposed to this change and posted my arguments in https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11094#issuecomment-3769076517 it's not captured there but a member of the solc team expressed the same concern about increasing the size of EXCHANGE instructions on acdt #66, devs agreed not to include this pr in devnet 2 due to a lack of consensus on it, https://christinedkim.substack.com/p/acdt-66 https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/066 [7:22]
